text: Jean-Gabriel Griboul has 20 years of experience advising clients on private and public M&A, PE (private equity), and ECM (equity capital market) transactions, including domestic and cross-border acquisitions or investments, divestitures and strategic alliances, and corporate law issues. He is recognized in numerous legal publications, including Chambers Europe that notes "his commercial sense is valued by clients, one dubbing him ‘efficient, precise and pragmatic’." Jean-Gabriel has acted as principal lawyer in a significant number of early to late-stage financing rounds, M&A transactions, LBOs (leveraged buyouts), IPOs (initial public offerings), rights issues, tender offers, and private placements. Recent transactions in which Jean-Gabriel has acted as lead lawyer include: M&A: sale of Efficient IP to Francisco Partners; build-up acquisitions completed by Doctolib; acquisition by Taranis Investments (Perenco Group) of the African project portfolio of Akuo Energy Afrique; acquisition by DBG Technology of All Circuits; joint venture between EDF Invest and Savills Investment Management; acquisition of Bimpli (BPCE) by Swile; sale of Preligens to Safran; sale of Gleamer to RadNet; and sale of Linkfluence to Meltwater. Private Equity: LBO of Illuin Technology; MBO (management buyout) of Adikteev; Sanofi's investment in a biotech entity controlled by Orano Med; all financing rounds completed by Swile; Unseenlabs Series C financing round; and ADEME Investissement on the offshore floating wind development company created with BW Ideol. Capital Markets: Nasdaq IPO of Nanobiotix and ChapsVision tender offer on Coheris. Experience Additional Speaking Engagements - 12 avril 2018 Finale de la 4ème édition du Prix Jones Day/Paris II/ESSEC - 7 janvier 2016 Le private equity : quelles opportunités pour 2016 ? "He is highly available, provides good advice, delivers on time with his team." - University of Montpellier I (Magistère-DJCE-DESS in Business Law 2003; Master's in Business Law 2002); EDHEC Business School (M.B.A. 2001); Institut d'Etudes Politiques of Bordeaux (Sciences Po — section Service Public 1999) - Paris Bar - Acknowledged as the #1 venture/growth capital team in France since 2000 in top legal rankings First prize for IPOs and capital markets, Le Magazine des Affaires (since 2015) Paris M&A team ranked Band 1 in "Mid-cap M&A" in France, Option Droit & Affaires Paris M&A team ranked 4 stars for M&A deals over €200 million in France, Option Droit & Affaires - English, French
